digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Wednesday, September 9 has 12 meeting events, 10 carried-over items, and five urgent actions. The day turns on keeping Amazon Connect UAT moving toward Friday's 80% target, clearing the remaining access and channel issues, and choosing coverage for the 10:30 AM conflict and the compressed 2:00-5:00 PM block. The KM/Legal discussion and executive updates deck are the other decision points to protect. Repository state was last modified Monday morning, so completion status may be stale.

items.label: Finish clearing Amazon Connect UAT access and channel blockers
items.detail: Permissions were configured for several testers and David Lopez confirmed access, but Omni-Channel visibility, test-script access, and shared-channel requests, including Luis Surmay's workbook request, still need follow-through before today's working sessions.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including the required permissions and monitoring, before UAT advances.

items.label: Finalize the Amazon Connect training audience
items.detail: Staff Augmentation externals were confirmed out of scope for the MVP. Confirm the remaining audience and complete the load plan while Round 2 testing is underway.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested review and add the slide covering EPMO projects completed in August before the leadership discussion.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP and training path
items.detail: Use the 11:30 AM KM and Legal Compliance discussion to confirm project overlap, secure the remaining approvals, and protect the September 15 Contigo launch.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: This remains open across multiple briefings. Close stale entries and leave one current operating view before this week's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing.

items.label: Confirm the Enterprise Knowledge Management project record
items.detail: Confirm with Eugenia whether the recently deleted project record was intentional and which record should remain authoritative.

items.label: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access
items.detail: Approve or decline Sara's SharePoint request after confirming that the Client Services training material is appropriate for her role.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the Thiago 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while next week's Amazon Connect UAT and go-live work are arranged.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Thiago 1:1 conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Choose the priority or delegate standup coverage before the first block begins.

items.label: 11:30 AM-1:30 PM - Legal decisions, then protected work
items.detail: The KM and Legal Compliance discussion is followed by a 90-minute blocked space that can absorb deck work or unresolved UAT access follow-up.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - Three-way overlap across EPMO, UAT, and 1:1s
items.detail: The EPMO team meeting overlaps Group 4 UAT and the Astrid 1:1; CM CoE Guidance then overlaps Group 2 UAT. Confirm attendance and delegation before 2:00 PM.

items.label: 3:30-6:00 PM - Compressed UAT and leadership sequence
items.detail: Laura, weekly-meeting prep, and Sara run alongside Groups 2 and 3, followed immediately by Group 1 at 5:00 PM. Protect a clear UAT escalation path while moving between meetings.

items.label: Set today's Amazon Connect UAT checkpoint
items.detail: Round 2 opened with 18 of 26 testers attending, or 69%. Ask for an end-of-day completion readout by group, the no-show recovery status, and any confirmed blockers so the team stays on track for at least 80% completion by Friday.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: An unread action-required notice reports security vulnerabilities in one or more projects. Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is needed.

items.label: Mauricio Concha is out through Friday
items.detail: Plan decisions and follow-ups that normally depend on Mauricio around his absence.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Standup, Armando 1:1, and Amazon weekly sync
items.detail: The morning sequence is compact; bring the reconciled Asana view and today's UAT progress into the relevant conversations.

items.label: 2:15-4:00 PM - UAT Groups 4 and 2
items.detail: Group 4 overlaps Group 2 from 3:00-3:15 PM, so maintain champion coverage and a single escalation channel.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Weekly meeting conflicts with Group 3 UAT
items.detail: Choose attendance or delegate UAT coverage before the weekly meeting; Group 1 follows at 5:00 PM.
